cover.note: Rhythm built from Melissa's SOPs dated 28 Sep 2026 (Motion Ads, iXperience ZA, iXperience USA). Country Hotels has no SOP yet. Items tagged confirm are open points in the SOPs.

ix.name: iX ZA
ix.systems: Xero, eFiling, Mr H. Reviewer approves all SARS returns and releases payments

ixusa.name: iX USA
ixusa.systems: Xero, Dext, HubSpot, Mercury, Chase, Mr H

rhythm.title: Morning inbox, all entities
rhythm.how: Read Claude's brief and the draft replies first. Send or fix the drafts. Anything needing Xero goes into the capture box for the Xero hour. Log ad hoc requests from the Motion Ads team and follow them until closed.

rhythm.title: Chase missing documents and unknown transactions
rhythm.how: Open Missing documents. Claude has already built the list from Mercury and Xero, grouped by person. Copy each chase message and send it. Unknown bank lines sit in Suspense with a note until someone answers.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: bank feeds, supplier and sales invoices, anomalies, reconcile
rhythm.how: Code all new bank lines. Capture supplier invoices and match to payments. Process any sale against its client contract on the day it arrives. Look for unusual, duplicate or unexpected lines. Reconcile to the latest statement balance.

rhythm.title: iX ZA: bank lines, balance check, bills and sales invoices, daily log
rhythm.how: Every feed line matched or coded with the right VAT rate and a document attached. Unknowns go to Suspense and to the reviewer today. Agree each Xero balance to the bank and record it in the daily log (date, account, balance, initials). Capture bills only from valid tax invoices, check for duplicates.

rhythm.title: iX USA: four feeds and the Dext inbox
rhythm.how: Reconcile Mercury main, Chase main, Chase credit card and Aaron's Mercury card, with account and tracking category. Publish Dext items after checking supplier, date, number, amount, currency and tax. Match bills already paid to the bank line.

rhythm.title: Xero queue: POs and requests captured today
rhythm.how: Work the queue top down. Anything not finished rolls to tomorrow.

rhythm.title: Daily sign off and tomorrow's musts
rhythm.how: All feeds processed, balances agree, bills and invoices captured, Suspense items sent to the reviewer. Mark tomorrow's musts.

rhythm.title: Plan the week: aged receivables and payables per entity
rhythm.how: Ask Claude for the aged lists per org. Anything over 30 days gets a follow up. Note what is due in this week's payment runs.

rhythm.title: Country Hotels FM check in
rhythm.how: No SOP yet. Cover the FM basics: cash position, payables due, payroll inputs, anything waiting on sign off.

rhythm.title: iX USA weekly: HubSpot invoices into Xero and match receipts
rhythm.how: Bring in every HubSpot invoice since the last run with the channel tracking (Cape Town, Online, Lisbon). Count and total must agree to HubSpot. Match customer receipts, handle deposits, part payments and refunds. List anything paid in HubSpot with no bank receipt, or the reverse.

rhythm.title: iX USA: remind the US trip team to upload Mercury receipts
rhythm.how: Claude lists card spend without a receipt by cardholder. Send each person their list and ask them to upload in the Mercury app. Attach the receipts in Xero once they land.

rhythm.title: iX USA: BD incentive and referral payouts
rhythm.how: Calculate from the incentive trackers. Check each payout against a booked and paid sale. Get approval (approver still to confirm), pay and record in Xero.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: prepare supplier payments and load for Friday
rhythm.how: Compile what is due this week, check each bill is approved and not already paid, and bank details match the supplier record. Get approval and load the batch so it goes out on Friday.

rhythm.title: iX ZA weekly: supplier payments and Mr H review
rhythm.how: Aged payables: list bills due by end of next week. Check approved, not paid, bank details match. Send the list with total and available balance to the reviewer, load once approved (reviewer releases), send remittances. Then confirm the daily sign offs, export the week's GL, bills and invoices to the Mr H folder raw subfolder and run Mr H. Correct or explain every flag.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: payments out, remittances, Mr H, missing invoices, PaySoft recon
rhythm.how: Confirm Wednesday's batch released and send proofs of payment. Run Mr H on the week and fix what it flags. Request any supplier invoices still missing. Reconcile PaySoft for the week.

rhythm.title: iX USA: Mr H weekly run
rhythm.how: Once HubSpot, receipts and payouts are posted, run Mr H and clear the exceptions.

rhythm.title: iXperience weekly financial report
rhythm.how: Ask Claude to run the iX weekly report, review the draft, then publish.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: send statements and this month's invoices
rhythm.how: Statements for anything still outstanding from last month, plus every invoice due this month so clients have them on hand.

rhythm.title: iX ZA: EMP201 to reviewer, then submit and pay
rhythm.how: Internal deadline, one business day ahead of SARS. Payroll final, pull PAYE, UIF and SDL, agree to the control accounts, prepare on eFiling, send to the reviewer with the payroll report. Once approved, submit and pay with the PRN. Post the payment in Xero.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: collect payroll changes and send to Justin and Ilan
rhythm.how: Gather leave, overtime, new starters and leavers for the month.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: payment reminders to all customers
rhythm.how: Remind every customer before their due date on the 25th or 30th. Claude can draft these.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads: pay payroll
rhythm.how: Process salary payments.

rhythm.title: iX ZA: payroll and VAT201
rhythm.how: Confirm the period's invoices are captured and banks reconciled. Run the Xero VAT report, check output VAT, input VAT only on valid tax invoices, zero rated and exempt coding. Agree to the VAT control account. Send to the reviewer stating payment or refund and the amount. Submit once approved. SARS deadline is the last business day of the month.

rhythm.title: Motion Ads month end: PaySoft journal, supplier invoices, VAT close off, royalty recon
rhythm.how: Post the PaySoft journal. Request invoices that don't arrive by themselves, such as rentals. Close VAT off every month: agree the VAT control account to the Xero VAT report. Royalty recon with Tristan.

rhythm.title: iX USA month end with Mr H, ready for management accounts
rhythm.how: Four accounts reconciled to statements, Suspense cleared, aged payables and receivables reviewed, every Mercury card line has a receipt. HubSpot agrees to Xero by channel. BD, referral and Danny's offshore payments checked. Cost review. Run Mr H month end and hand over for management accounts.

rhythm.title: iX ZA month end with Mr H
rhythm.how: Run Mr H month end on iX ZA. Clear exceptions before management accounts.

tone: Short, warm and direct. Three to six sentences unless the question needs more.
South African English spelling. Amounts as R12,500.00.
Always say what happens next and when: a day or a date, never 'soon'.
Never promise a payment date unless the bill is approved and in a payment run.
Do not use dashes as punctuation.
No attachments are mentioned unless they are actually attached.

rules.match: supplier or staff asks to change banking details
rules.do: Never change details from an email. Reply with the verification template and call the supplier on a number already on file.

rules.match: salary, payslip or someone else's pay
rules.do: Reply only to the employee concerned. Never copy others.

rules.match: any letter or email from SARS
rules.do: Put it on today's list as a must. Check eFiling before replying.

rules.match: request to pay today, outside the payment run
rules.do: Get written approval from the MD before loading. Treat urgency plus new bank details as likely fraud.

rules.match: PO, bill, invoice, credit note or statement request
rules.do: Acknowledge now with the holding template. Do the work in the 16:00 Xero hour.

templates.name: Received, doing it today
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks, received. I'll process this in this afternoon's Xero session and send it through by 17:00 today.

[Signoff]

templates.name: When will I be paid
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks for following up. Invoice [number] for R[amount] is approved and scheduled for our [day] payment run on [date]. I'll send the proof of payment as soon as it is released.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Invoice not on our system
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

I can't find invoice [number] on our system. Please could you resend it with the purchase order number on it? Once I have it, it goes into the next payment run on [day].

[Signoff]

templates.name: Proof of payment
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Please find attached proof of payment for R[amount] covering invoice [number]. It should reflect within one to two business days.

[Signoff]

templates.name: PO request
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks. To raise the PO I need the supplier, a quote or amount, and which cost centre it falls under. I'll create it in this afternoon's Xero session and send it to you by 17:00.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Overdue reminder to client
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

A friendly reminder that invoice [number] for R[amount] was due on [date]. Please could you let me know when we can expect payment? I've attached a statement for your records.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Bank detail change, verification
templates.when: Any request to change bank details
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks for letting us know. For security we don't update banking details from an email. Please send a signed letter on your letterhead together with a bank confirmation letter, and we will confirm the change by phone with our existing contact before any payment is made to the new account.

[Signoff]

templates.name: Payroll query
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thanks for your message. I'm checking this against the payroll and will come back to you by [day].

[Signoff]

templates.name: Missing receipt
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

These card transactions still have no receipt in Mercury:

[list]

Please upload a photo of each one in the Mercury app by Friday so I can close the week.

[Signoff]
